source.title: Safety outcomes of SGLT2i in the heart failure trials: A systematic review and Meta-analysis

schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated systematic-review/meta-analysis result atom kind; review-level pooled safety findings are represented as adverse_event atoms with systematic_review/meta_analysis/review_level_evidence tags.
extraction_limitations: Reference-list entries were not atomized; they are provenance infrastructure and are extracted separately to Markdown.
The study-selection sentence concerning smaller trials and “Phase 2 and 3 clinical trials” is syntactically ambiguous in the source; no stronger phase-based eligibility claim was inferred.
Appendix B Figure 7 contains a hyperkalemia panel that duplicates the AKI rows and pooled estimate; no HFpEF-exclusion hyperkalemia atom was created from that internally inconsistent panel.
